    Twisted multiplicative bases #

    A twisted multiplicative basis of a k-algebra A over a finite ray category P is a family elt f ∈ A of the morphisms of P, zero exactly on zero morphisms, whose nonzero members form a basis, with elt g * elt f = tw f g • elt (f ≫ g) for normalized scalars tw f g ∈ kˣ, elt g * elt f = 0 for non-composable f, g, and ∑ₓ elt (𝟙 x) = 1 (Gabriel–Roiter 13.9: the twisted linearizations k^f(P)). The linearization k(P) has one with tw = 1 (RayQuiver.linMulBasis).

    Type (max u_1 u_2)

    A twisted multiplicative basis of A over P.

    • elt {x y : P} : (x ⟶ y) → A
    • tw {x y z : P} : (x ⟶ y) → (y ⟶ z) → kˣ
    • elt_zero {x y : P} : self.elt 0 = 0
    • elt_mul {x y z : P} (f : x ⟶ y) (g : y ⟶ z) : self.elt g * self.elt f = ↑(self.tw f g) • self.elt (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g)
    • elt_mul_ne {x y y' z : P} (f : x ⟶ y) (g : y' ⟶ z) : y ≠ y' → self.elt g * self.elt f = 0
    • sum_id : ∑ x : P, self.elt (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id x) = 1
    • tw_id_left {x y : P} (f : x ⟶ y) : self.tw (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id x) f = 1
    • tw_id_right {x y : P} (f : x ⟶ y) : self.tw f (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id y) = 1
    • linearIndependent : LinearIndependent k fun (μ : NZ P) => self.elt ↑μ.snd.snd
    • span : Submodule.span k (Set.range fun (μ : NZ P) => self.elt ↑μ.snd.snd) = ⊤
